note: Answer key. Never give this directory to the agent under test. 'anchor' is a substring that must match exactly one line of the fixture, or a list of them when the fix can reasonably go in more than one place; the scorer turns anchors into line numbers, so the key survives edits elsewhere in the file. 'required' defects count toward recall; 'optional' ones are real but minor, so reporting them neither helps recall nor hurts precision.

defects.why: 80px rise plus scale on load with no prefers-reduced-motion path.
Scroll parallax ignores the user's reduced-motion preference.
Looping background video with no pause control (WCAG 2.2.2) and no reduced-motion handling.
Non-passive scroll handler writes style on every event without requestAnimationFrame.
Hover lift animates the layout properties top and width (transition on the .card rule) instead of transform.
Permanent will-change on 24 cards, including layout properties.
Layout thrash: reads geometry and writes width per card inside a scroll handler.
'Learn more' is only visible on hover: invisible on touch and when focused by keyboard.
Progress bar animates width rather than scaleX.
Uncancelled timeouts: open, close, reopen within 350 ms leaves the modal hidden or half-visible.
Focus is not moved into the dialog or returned on close; no Escape; no dialog role.
Removes the visible focus indicator.
Small scale transition without a reduced-motion branch.
requestAnimationFrame loop is never cancelled; each remount starts another loop that keeps writing to a detached node.
Observer is never disconnected; a new one is created on every mount.
Resize listener added on every mount and never removed.
Counter changes forever with no stop, pause, or reduced-motion path (WCAG 2.2.2).
touch-action: none on the whole page blocks scrolling and pinch zoom on touch devices.
Controls appear only on hover.
Dots are divs with click handlers: not focusable, no names, unusable by keyboard.
Auto-rotation never pauses (hover, focus, swipe, reduced motion) and has no stop control.
Slide transition has no reduced-motion branch; minor next to the autoplay.
touchstart listener is not marked passive.
Control page. The fade never actually runs when <details> opens; noting that is accurate, not a defect.
Expanding details animates max-height, which re-runs layout every frame; use grid-template-rows, a transform reveal, or no animation.
The reduced-motion block only turns off CSS animations; every motion on the page is a transition (max-height, the scale, transition: all), so nothing changes for the user.

Each click starts a new requestAnimationFrame tween without cancelling the running one, and reads its start value from the half-tweened text; fast clicks leave competing loops and a wrong final price.
The JavaScript number tween never checks prefers-reduced-motion, and the CSS media query cannot reach it.
transition: all animates whatever changes on the card, including layout properties.
Smooth scrolling for in-page links with no prefers-reduced-motion override.
Compacting the sticky header animates height, which relayouts the page under it on every frame while scrolling.
The hidden header keeps its links in the tab order and does not come back on focus, so keyboard users tab onto links they cannot see.

The scroll listener is added when the viewport becomes wide but never removed when it becomes narrow, so the hide-on-scroll header keeps running on small screens. (Repeat adds of the same function are deduplicated, so it does not accumulate.)
Header hide and compact transitions have no reduced-motion branch.
